credit_metrics.text: EBITDA rose by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}}, but operating profit fell by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}} as the weakening of the krone against the dollar weighed on the result.

Total debt increased by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, leaving gross leverage broadly unchanged at {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}.
Interest coverage weakened by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.
FFO increased by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, but FFO to debt slipped by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} as debt grew faster than cash generation.
Free cash flow increased by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, lifting FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, above the peer median.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments rose by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity increased by the same {{cash_liquidity.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}}.
Cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2024}}.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a growing part of the cash is customer prepayments.
The Board intends to propose a profit distribution per share, subject to approval from debt instrument holders, and financing terms for upcoming aircraft deliveries were secured on favourable terms.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, helped by the Widerøe acquisition and a modest increase of a single aircraft from Boeing delivery delays.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median.
In FY2023 the group carried {{passengers@FY2023}} passengers on {{ask@FY2023}} available seat kilometres, with a load factor of {{load_factor@FY2023}} and a fleet of {{fleet@FY2023}} aircraft.
Unit economics in FY2023 showed RASK of {{rask@FY2023}} against CASK of {{cask@FY2023}}, with CASK ex-fuel at {{cask_ex_fuel@FY2023}}.
Collective bargaining agreements concluded during the year raised personnel cost across several markets, while the risk of industrial action was lower.
